docs.title: Po family injects capital into parent firm of Century Pacific, Shakey’s Pizza
docs.text:
The Po family is injecting fresh capital into its flagship holding company, Century Pacific Group Inc. (CPGI), the parent of listed firms Century Pacific Food Inc. and Shakey’s Pizza Asia Ventures Inc.
The investment was made through Zephryn Holdings, another Po family-owned vehicle, which subscribed to new redeemable preferred shares issued by CPGI.
The deal gives Zephryn a 45 percent stake in CPGI and indirect ownership of 29.9 percent in Century Pacific Food and 29.15 percent in Shakey’s Pizza.
Despite the restructuring, overall control and ownership of the group remain firmly within the Po family.
Shakey’s shares slipped 1.36 percent to P7.27 each, while Century Pacific was down 1.16 percent to P34.15 each. The two firms have a combined market value of around P135 billion.
Data from the Securities and Exchange Commission showed that Zephryn Holdings Inc. is an investment firm established on Nov. 11, 2024.
Corporate records show it is led by Ricardo T. Po (vice chair), Christopher T. Po (president), Teodoro Alexander T. Po (chief operating officer), and Leonardo T. Po (treasurer).
The company is chaired by Fernan Lukban, who also sits on the boards of other Po family-controlled firms.

docs.title: GERI: Clarification of News Reports
docs.text:
Clarification on the news article “Megaworld unit GERI to launch projects in 3 provinces” posted on June 25, 2026.

We reply to your request for clarification on the news article “Megaworld unit GERI to launch projects in 3 provinces” posted on June 25, 2026 which reported that:“Global-Estate Resorts Inc. (GERI) said Thursday it will launch new developments in Cagayan de Oro, Iloilo and Batangas as part of its 2026 expansion strategy.The unit of Megaworld Corp. said it is securing regulatory approval for the projects, which it expects will expand its market footprint, generate new revenue streams and boost construction and service demand in host communities.GERI is also spending P11 billion to complete ongoing projects across its integrated tourism estates and lifestyle communities. The capital will primarily fund developments in Arden Botanical Estate in Cavite, Boracay New Coast in Aklan and Twin Lakes in Batangas.. . . . ”Global-Estate Resorts, Inc. ("Company") confirms that it will launch new developments in Cagayan de Oro, Iloilo, and Batangas as part of its 2026 expansion strategy, subject to regulatory approvals.With respect to the statement that the Company is also spending P11 billion to complete ongoing developments, primarily across Arden Botanical Estate in Cavite, Boracay New Coast in Aklan, and Twin Lakes in Batangas, the Company clarifies that the said amount does not pertain to development or construction cost. Rather, it pertains to the P11 billion worth of residential and commercial projects of the Company in various locations outside Metro Manila, which was the subject of an earlier Press Release filed with the PSE on 7 May 2026.We trust that we have clarified the above-mentioned news article to your satisfaction.

The Company notes that the source of the article entitled “Megaworld unit GERI to launch projects in 3 provinces” is Manila Standard.
